To determine how many runs a player scored in a specific match we must sum the runs recorded in the batsman_scored table, which stores runs per ball. The striker (player) for each ball is stored in ball_by_ball, so we join ball_by_ball with batsman_scored to aggregate runs per player per match. The player_match table links each player to the team they represented in a given match, allowing us to check whether the player was playing for the losing side. The match table provides the match outcome (match_winner) so we can identify the losing team (the team that is not match_winner). Combining these tables lets us filter for players who scored ≥100 runs while their team lost the match.
